The selected water-matter pathway retains the left surface reservoir and joined right catchment outline, one cloud reference with three enlarged liquid-droplet rings, three separate rain teardrops, and evaporation, rainfall and surface-return arrows. Geometry is re-laid out vertically and droplet bodies widened independently to meet physical feature sizes; the original 1.4 mm lines remain. Vapour is invisible and represented by the externally keyed upward path, not the cloud droplet circles. Liquid rainfall is one selected precipitation case, not an exhaustive water cycle.
